entities.name: Aleksandar
entities.description: Young human blacksmith's son from Innistrad who became host to Umbris.

entities.name: Umbris
entities.description: Nightmare horror that used the keep as a lair and possessed Aleksandar.

entities.name: Torens
entities.description: Outsider who advocated for Aleksandar and bargained with Umbris.

entities.name: The keep
entities.description: Keep used by Umbris as a lair.

events.summary: Aleksandar pleads with Vytas for more time on rent; Torens advocates and Aleksandar is assigned to help investigate the keep.
events.quote: Torens's sympathy led to Aleksandar being assigned to help with the investigation

events.summary: Aleksandar follows Torens and Boris into the keep against his father's wishes.
events.quote: Aleksandar, despite his father's insistence that he stay behind, chose to follow them.

events.summary: Torens and Aleksandar meet Eruth and learn Vytas and Boris are cultists serving Umbris.
events.quote: It was revealed that Vytas and Boris were cultists

events.summary: Aleksandar is found bound in runes as a vessel for Umbris.
events.quote: Aleksandar, now a vessel for Umbris, was bound in a circle of runes

events.summary: Torens bargains with Umbris to free Aleksandar in exchange for its freedom; villagers stone Boris and Vytas.
events.quote: Torens made a deal with Umbris to relinquish control of Aleksandar for its freedom.

events.summary: Torens swears to hunt the nightmare down.
events.quote: swearing to hunt the nightmare down

relations.quote: It was revealed that Vytas and Boris were cultists
swearing to hunt the nightmare down
though Torens , an outsider, advocated for him
